abstract: An intraoral approach to dermoid cysts of the floor of the mouth is described. With this technique, it is possible to obtain adequate surgical access in cases of very large dermoid cysts involving simultaneously the floor of the mouth and the submental space, thus avoiding a skin incision in the submental fold.
abstract_ja: 口腔底の類皮嚢腫に対する口腔内アプローチを記載する。本法により、口腔底と顎下部にまたがる非常に大きな類皮嚢腫に対して、オトガイ下部の皮膚切開を行わずに十分な術野を確保できる。
